entities.summary: Wadja Egnankou is a scientist from Côte d'Ivoire, a researcher at the University of Abidjan. He is a botanist, wetland expert and lecturer at the University of Abidjan, Cote d’Ivoire. He is also the founder and president of the NGO SOS-FORETS. He received the Goldman Environmental Prize in 1992 for his efforts to protect the mangrove forests of the country.
